errors.mcapWarmupTitle: Market-cap data may be warming up
errors.mcapWarmupBody: If the supply snapshot is empty, mcap sorts can fail. Switch sort to Quote volume or retry.
errors.upstreamMcap: Upstream or supply snapshot unavailable. Market-cap sorts need a warm supply cache — try quote volume sort or retry shortly.
errors.refreshFailed: Could not refresh markets — showing last successful data.

delist.disabledBody: Set BINANCE_API_KEY on the backend to load Binance’s official spot delist schedule. Bybit uses public announcements (no key). Delist dates then appear as tags in the Tags column.
delist.unsupportedBody: This venue has no public upcoming-delist calendar. Pairs still trading stay in the list without a date.
delist.activeHint: {{count}} pair(s) delisted in the last 30 days or scheduled in the next month — see the amber Delist tag.
